Identity._comment: LS-INT-01: Master switch. Enabled=false (default) preserves standalone X-Internal-Token + X-Tenant-Id behavior completely unchanged. Set Enabled=true and supply SigningKey via BILLING_LEGALSYNQ_SIGNING_KEY env var (must equal Jwt__SigningKey in LegalSynq Identity service) to activate JWT authentication.

TenantContext._comment: LS-INT-01: Dual-mode tenant context resolution. Enabled=false (default) → header-only path unchanged. Enabled=true → resolver hierarchy: JWT tenant_id claim → internal-service JWT + X-Tenant-Id header → X-Tenant-Id header fallback.

// Billing.Delivery: MS-BILL-INT-002 — statement delivery provider selection. Provider 'Noop' (default) preserves the WRITE-009 deterministic 'Email delivery is not configured yet' UX. Set Provider='Ncm' AND populate Billing:Delivery:Ncm:{BaseUrl,ApiKey,TemplateCode} to enable the real NCM-backed transport. ApiKey MUST be sourced from the platform secret store in production — NEVER commit a real value here.
// Billing.Delivery.Retry: MS-BILL-INT-003 — synchronous, operator-driven resend governance. MaxAttempts caps the persisted DeliveryRetryCount before further resends are 429/409-rejected; CooldownSeconds is the minimum spacing between consecutive resends on the same snapshot. ProviderHealth is an in-memory rolling-window signal for operator visibility only — it never gates a click. Defaults are safe; tune per deployment.
// Billing.EntitlementEnforcement: TB-ENF-01 — soft-enforcement gate. Master switch defaults Enabled=false (no behaviour change). When opted in, UnknownMode/GraceLimitedMode (ReadOnly|Block) decide how missing-snapshot and grace-window tenants are handled; AllowPaymentsInReadOnly=true preserves payment-recovery flows while AR is degraded; AllowStatementsInReadOnly=true preserves statement generation; AllowExportsInReadOnly=false pins external ERP/QuickBooks side-effects off until full Allow.

Billing.// Erp.QuickBooks: MS-BILL-ERP-002 — QuickBooks Online provider config. ALL fields server-side only; never logged, never exposed to the browser. RealmId/ClientId/ClientSecret/RefreshToken MUST be sourced from the platform secret store in production — NEVER commit real values here. Account refs are QBO chart-of-account IDs the operator has pre-created in QuickBooks. Environment is 'production' (default) or 'sandbox'. When ANY required field is empty the orchestrator falls through to the existing NoOp default (deterministic ProviderUnavailable banner) — half-configured deployments never silently send to the wrong realm.

QuickBooks.// ExportMode: MS-BILL-ERP-003 — provider-wide export-mode toggle. 'JournalEntry' (default) preserves the ERP-002 path. 'InvoiceFirst' posts a QBO Invoice per AccountingExportInvoice resolved through the operator-curated quickbooks_customer_mappings table. Unknown values fall through to 'JournalEntry'.
QuickBooks.// FallbackCustomerRef: MS-BILL-ERP-003 — optional QBO customer ref used when InvoiceFirst encounters an unmapped Billing customer. Honored only when FallbackCustomerEnabled is true. Empty / disabled = strict mapping-only mode (unmapped customer surfaces deterministic Failed; provider NEVER auto-creates a QBO Customer).
